value.rationale: The 2026 weak-edge reduction motivates the physically natural three-component endpoint-transport optimization. A complete exact classification of arbitrary asymmetries and rational resonance defects goes beyond finding perfect designs; it gives a quantitative unattainable fidelity ceiling and finite polynomial global optimizers. The realizable integer-arc-count triple (24,6,24) has a strict 17/81 loss even with mirror symmetry at odd/odd resonance, while (12,8,12) has perfect reduced-wave transfer. These identify an experimentally meaningful design boundary without conflating finite-weight quantum-walk dynamics.
